title: Why Do Tigers Have Such Rough Tongues?

scenes.text: A tiger's tongue is covered in 1,000 spines
These spines are made of keratin, the same protein as human hair
The spines on a tiger's tongue can be up to 0.5 mm long
And they help tigers scrape meat off bones with ease
Follow if you love learning something new.

description: A tiger's tongue is a powerful tool that helps them eat their prey. But what makes it so special? Find out the surprising truth behind a tiger's rough tongue. Follow us for more mind-blowing animal facts!
